Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits.

If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase .
You'll join the Customer Experience and Engagement product team as its founding design hire, owning end-to-end design across Coinbase's AI-first customer support platform.

The team builds the Help Center, Chatbot, Voicebot, and the premium Concierge support experience embedded inside the Coinbase app, with a mission to automate 90%+ of customer interactions by EOY 2026 while delivering the highest-quality support experience in fintech.

You'll define the design vision across this full product surface and shape how millions of customers get help, driving measurable impact on automation quality, customer satisfaction, and Concierge revenue.

Own end-to-end design vision and execution across the full CX product surface, spanning Help Center, Chatbot, Voicebot, and the in-app Concierge support experience.
Drive MVP and future-state concepts across the AI-powered support ecosystem, including self-service flows, conversational interactions, escalation paths, and proactive outreach surfaces.
Lead design for Concierge, Coinbase's premium support product, translating a $50M+ revenue goal into a high-touch, differentiated in-app experience.
Partner with Product, Engineering, and CX Operations to ground design decisions in real support data, automation performance metrics, and customer satisfaction signals.
Shape a reusable design system pattern library for AI-powered support, collaborating with the Coinbase Design System team to ensure consistency across Help Center, Chatbot, and Voicebot.
Build direct relationships with customers and support agents to generate insights that influence how Coinbase delivers world-class support at scale.

7+ years of Product Design experience with meaningful work on support, service, conversational UI, or AI-powered interfaces.
Track record of shipping end-to-end product design across both customer-facing and operator-facing (agent/internal tooling) surfaces within cross-functional teams.
Demonstrated ability to work autonomously across a complex, multi-surface product ecosystem, from early concept through production launch.
Mastery of visual design, interaction design, and conversation flow design, with fluency in Figma and modern prototyping tools.
Strong cross-functional communication and stakeholder management across engineering, product, operations, and executive audiences.
Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

Our mission at Duolingo is to develop the best education in the world and make it universally available. It’s a big mission, and even though we've made a lot of headway, we still have work to do — and that’s where you come in!
Duolingo’s designers care about creating high-quality experiences that look and feel fun . From animators to writers, product designers to researchers, Design brings purpose, feeling, and delight to every interaction with our brand, inside the app and out. As a designer, you’ll join a culture of creativity and craft, where we have a high bar for excellence and an endless curiosity about how to bring more unexpected quirk and fun to the pursuit of learning.
Join us in our mission to develop education for our half a billion (and growing!) learners around the world.

This role is an important part of the Design team, partnering with other designers and cross-functional teammates on features across our mobile apps, website, and communications. From polishing learner flows to supporting campaigns and community moments, you’ll help shape friendly, intuitive experiences that feel distinctly Duolingo. We care deeply about craft, so you’ll grow your skills while contributing to work that’s both user-friendly and fun, sweating the details to get them just right.
🧠You will...
Design and prototype simple, playful learning experiences for the Duolingo app
Drive large work streams across your team with independence—you’ll lead!
Be a peer leader and mentor across Duolingo Design
Work with other designers and artists to expand Duolingo’s design language
Partner with engineers and product managers to define what we build, and how we get there
Consider every part of a finely crafted experience: animation, copy, UI to business impact
✅ You have...
An online portfolio featuring simple consumer mobile apps
The highest bar for visual design and interaction details
Fluency in creating high fidelity prototypes quickly
Experience shipping products at scale in a product organization
The ability to explain your work and decisions simply and concisely
A big appetite for feedback to help you make your best work
A bravery in solving hard problems within ambiguity and complexity
⭐Exceptional candidates will have...
The desire to make decisions fast
Know-how using AI and LLMs to make interesting ideas from scratch
Deep understanding for brand, and a brand’s role in business
Skills shaping motion and animation for user interfaces
A track record of career growth within previous companies
A reputation of being a top performer and is sought after by other leaders
The offered salary is dependent upon several factors, including work experience, skills, and internal peer comparisons. The posted range is subject to change in the future. For this role, base salary is supplemented by equity compensation. We encourage you to talk with your recruiter for more information related to compensation for this role!

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets.

By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly.

Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.
Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.
Design at Brex
Design at Brex creates the experiences that make complex systems feel effortless through thoughtful, scalable design. Whether crafting interfaces, shaping product strategy, or harnessing AI to empower our users, we obsess over quality and clarity. This is a team where creativity meets high craft, and where designers grow by building for ambitious customers.

You will work with Product and Engineering teams to successfully communicate, evolve, and execute a strong product design standard that showcases Brex as a leader in financial innovation.

You are a crucial component of our company’s growth and product launches through your contributions to short and long-term strategic direction, creating and maintaining high visual standards and a strong focus on user needs.

You have an owner’s mentality, taking pride in your work and in your team’s work, and view what you do as a part-owner and builder of Brex.
Where you’ll work
This role will be based in our San Francisco, Seattle, or New York office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require three days per week in office - Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Use creative thinking toward establishing and executing on the vision for the team initiatives
Challenge the status quo, push innovation, and inspire people toward a unified outcome
Efficiently execute to ship products that deliver impact for our business and customers
Partner with the leadership team to successfully communicate concisely across the team and influence product and design outcomes
Work across the entire business stack and make an impact at different stages of the product: building vision & strategy, ensuring all the loose ends are tied up when executing, and making sure the operational components to support onboarding are in place, not just the product
Contribute toward growing and scaling design across the broader company and within the Design org
Push forward and maintain a high design bar and level of execution
Work closely with stakeholders across the organization, p artnering with Engineering, Product, Operations, and Data teams to define and launch new products and features

Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a talent for detailed articulations of strategy, process, and leading cross-functional meetings to align teams
Experience working cross-functionally with engineering, marketing, design, and product management teams
Strong ability to craft a clear narrative and paint a vision that communicates and aligns teams
Passion for team building and development
10+ years of experience as a product designer
Experience building customer-facing products from 0 to 1

Experience working with tools including but not limited to Figma, Jira, Looker, Slack, Google Apps, Salesforce, Chrome Console
Experience working on products in both B2B and B2C companies
Experience writing/editing/contributing to documentation, training materials, and help articles to support product launches

The expected salary range for this role is $240,000 - $300,000. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.
Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a brex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.

We're looking for an experienced Product Designer who is passionate about solving real customer problems, thrives on turning complexity into simplicity, and loves using data, insight and experimentation to create exceptional digital experiences.
This is an opportunity to shape products used by millions of consumers to improve their financial health, working at the heart of a cross-functional product team where your ideas, creativity and customer focus will directly influence the experiences we build.
You'll work closely with Product Managers, Engineers, Researchers and other specialists to uncover customer needs, define opportunities, test ideas and design products that deliver meaningful outcomes for both our customers and the business.
Reporting to a Lead Product Designer, you'll also be part of a talented and collaborative design community where you'll share ideas, challenge thinking, develop your craft and help shape the future of design at Experian.

Lead the design of digital experiences across web and mobile, taking products from discovery through to launch and continuous optimisation.
Work closely with customers to uncover pain points, understand behaviours and identify opportunities to create value.
Transform insights, data and business goals into simple, intuitive and engaging user experiences.
Prototype and test ideas quickly, using experimentation and customer feedback to validate solutions and reduce risk.
Partner with Product Managers and Engineers to define problems, shape strategy and deliver impactful outcomes.
Use product metrics, customer data and performance measures to assess success and continuously improve experiences.
Navigate complex regulatory requirements while maintaining a relentless focus on customer needs.
Explore emerging technologies, including AI-powered design tools, to enhance the way we design and build products.
You've designed successful digital products in a consumer-focused environment and understand what drives customer engagement, loyalty and growth.
You have proven experience delivering end-to-end product design, from discovery and research through to launch and optimisation across web and mobile experiences.
You're a natural problem solver who loves turning complex challenges into simple, intuitive experiences that customers value.
You have a strong portfolio showcasing customer-centred design, measurable results, and commercial impact.
You bring an experimentation mindset, using research, testing, customer feedback, and data to validate ideas and drive better outcomes.
You understand product metrics and performance measures and know how to use data to inform decisions and demonstrate impact.
You're highly skilled in Figma, modern prototyping tools, design systems, and accessible design practices.
You thrive in collaborative Agile teams, enjoy influencing stakeholders, and are passionate about creating exceptional customer experiences.
Hybrid working - 40% office based

We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world.

That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it.

We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.
At Core Experience, we design many of Spotify’s most loved and most frequently used experiences. We help listeners discover, connect with, and build lasting relationships with the creators and content they care about most. Our designers work across a broad range of surfaces and product areas, partnering closely with cross-functional teams to shape experiences that reach hundreds of millions of listeners around the world.
We're looking for a Senior Product Designer to join Format Foundations, a product area focused on Spotify’s core content formats and the creators behind them. The team works across experiences including artists and albums, podcasts, audiobooks, clips, countdown pages, and emerging formats. This role will have an immediate focus on shaping Spotify’s end-to-end Fitness experience while helping define the future of new content experiences on the platform.

Design end-to-end product experiences that help listeners discover, engage with, and return to emerging content formats, including Fitness.

Create intuitive, visually compelling experiences across mobile-first consumer journeys.

Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Engineers, Researchers, Data Scientists, and fellow Designers to define opportunities and deliver meaningful outcomes.

Develop concepts, user flows, prototypes, and polished experiences that influence product strategy and execution.

Explore how new content formats should be experienced within Spotify and identify opportunities to evolve the product experience.

Shape experiences that strengthen the connection between listeners, creators, and content.

Contribute to long-term format innovation initiatives that support Spotify's broader catalog expansion strategy.

Leverage AI-powered workflows and emerging tools to accelerate design exploration, experimentation, and prototyping.

You have experience designing high-quality consumer products with a strong focus on user experience, interaction design, and visual craft.

You know how to create compelling prototypes that communicate ideas, test assumptions, and bring concepts to life.

You are experienced designing for mobile platforms and understand the nuances of creating exceptional mobile-first experiences.

You have strong visual design skills and a portfolio that demonstrates attention to detail and craft.

You are proficient in Figma and comfortable working across the full product design process.

You are curious about AI-enabled design workflows and are comfortable exploring tools such as Claude and other emerging technologies.

You have experience collaborating with cross-functional partners across Product, Engineering, Research, and Data.

You thrive in ambiguous spaces and enjoy helping define new products, experiences, and opportunities.

You have experience translating brand principles into scalable product experiences.

You care deeply about creating experiences that help users discover and build deeper relationships with content and creators.

You are comfortable working with ambiguity and enjoy navigating open-ended challenges, helping teams create clarity and move ideas forward.

Where You'll Be

This role is based in Stockholm.

We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in-person meetings, while still allowing flexibility to work from home.

About Zip
Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.
The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.
Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.

We're looking for a Product Designer to join our Procure-to-Pay (P2P) team and own product design for one of its core areas. P2P is the machinery that turns an approved purchase into a paid vendor: purchase orders, invoices, and payments, and the workflows that keep enterprise spend committed and accurate.

You'll join an established team with a dedicated PM, a strong engineering group, and direct lines to the customers you're designing for. You'll design this surface's first AI agents: purchase orders that maintain themselves, transactions that code and reconcile themselves.

Please note, we are looking for someone who will be able to come into our San Francisco office on a hybrid basis (3 days / week).
You will
Own end-to-end experiences at the core of P2P: creation and approval workflows, change management, alerts, and the dashboards enterprises run their spend on.
Partner closely with your PM and engineers to brainstorm, define, and implement new features and offerings, from core workflows to our first agents.
Design full transaction lifecycles, including the hard states (declines, disputes, failed payments) where user trust is won or lost.
Shape our first agent experiences, grounded in structured procurement data: automation that users can verify and trust.
Run your own research: get in front of customers through our SE, CS, and Sales partners, and test your work with the AP teams and requesters who live in these flows.
Participate in regular design reviews with the broader design team.

3-5 years of experience designing complex B2B or workflow products; procurement, payments, or fintech experience is a plus.
Experience shipping at least one full product or significant feature end to end as the lead designer.
Experience running your own research: finding the right customers, asking the right questions, and turning what you hear into design decisions.
Experience iterating closely with engineers on both UX and visual design to get the details just right.
A point of view: you can defend design decisions with PMs and engineers, and change your mind when the evidence says you should.
Curiosity about designing AI-assisted workflows; you don't need to have shipped an agent, but you should want to.
Fluency in Figma and prototyping tools.
Understanding of the technical constraints of building web applications.

You build with AI tools in your own workflow, prototyping with Claude, Figma Make, Cursor, or whatever gets your ideas into something clickable fastest.
Consumer-grade mobile experience: cardholders live on their phones, and receipts, approvals, and card use increasingly happen there.
The salary range for this role is $160,000 - $220,000. The salary for this position is determined based on a variety of job-related factors that may include location, relevant experience, education, or particular skills and expertise.

We're looking to hire Zipsters and that means hiring people who take ownership, communicate openly, have an underdog mindset, and are excited to increase the pace of innovation for every business in the world. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workspace where everyone (regardless of age, religion, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, and more) feels like they belong. We look forward to hearing from you!
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

Product Design at Affirm drives business success by exceeding user expectations. We are a collaborative, agile team that continues to strive for greater solutions. We partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Analytics to translate complex user needs into simple, intuitive, and scalable product experiences. We rely on empathy, design craft, and systems thinking to champion the user in every decision, ensuring our products empower people to manage their money with confidence.

We are looking for an experienced Staff Product Designer to join us at a critical juncture as we evolve how our users interact with Affirm through agentic solutions. You will lead the effort to help establish when, where and how we utilize AI to consistently help the consumer in the moment, providing them with proactive experiences. You will partner closely with Product to define a roadmap for success.
This role focuses on building a hybrid search and discovery interface that seamlessly balances the high-intent efficiency of traditional UI with the discovery power of AI. In addition, you will help create a unified vision on how AI can transform our consumer touchpoints.

Own and drive design AI and agentic initiatives for Affirm’s Consumer experience, delivering high-impact, customer-centric solutions that align with business objectives.
Design intuitive, conversational, and agentic patterns that feel proactive and helpful, moving beyond reactive commerce to anticipation.
Define the design language for Affirm’s future AI-driven interactions, prioritizing trust, clarity, and predictable outcomes for our users.
Collaborate cross-functionally with product, engineering, data science, marketing, and research to drive innovation and deliver seamless, intuitive experiences.
Embrace agility—iterating quickly, adapting to change, and making data-driven decisions while maintaining a strong vision for the future.
Balance near-term execution with long-term strategic thinking, ensuring scalability and coherence across the Affirm ecosystem.
Push the envelope—challenge the status quo, think outside the box, and take calculated risks to drive meaningful innovation in financial products.
Bring exceptional visual and interaction design skills to craft delightful, polished experiences that build trust and confidence.
Champion a test-and-learn mindset, leveraging experimentation, research, and analytics to continuously refine and optimize user experiences.
What we look for
AI Product Design & Strategic Vision
AI/Agentic Design Experience: Proven track record of designing AI-driven, agentic, or conversational user interfaces that deliver real user value.
Advanced Prototyping: Proficiency in prototyping non-linear, multi-modal user flows to test and validate complex AI interactions.
Human-Centered AI Principles: Strong understanding of HCAI principles, focusing on user trust, transparency, system feedback, and explainability.
High-Stakes Design: Ability to navigate and design for complex, high-stakes consumer financial products where trust is paramount.
Leadership & Strategy
Experience at Scale: 8+ years of product design experience with significant time dedicated to problem solving complex experiences and shipping new products.
Proactive & Adaptable: You thrive in fast-paced, evolving environments and take initiative to drive progress.
Strong Product Sense: You deeply understand user needs, business goals, and technical constraints—and can balance them effectively in your design decisions.
Data-Informed & Risk-Taking: You use data to guide your thinking but aren’t afraid to challenge assumptions and explore bold ideas.
Collaborative & Humble: You value diverse perspectives, work well with cross-functional partners, and are open to feedback to make the best decisions for our users.
Exceptional Craft & Visual Skills: You have a keen eye for detail, design systems, and interaction patterns that elevate user experiences.
Passion for Innovation: You’re excited about the challenge of designing financial products that improve people’s lives and want to push the industry forward.
Pay Grade - N
Equity Grade - 12

Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.
Our mission on the Consumer team is to improve both the quality and depth of Discord’s core product value - which is to make Discord the best place to hang out online and play games with friends. Millions of people use Discord every day to find belonging, create connections, and talk… and we are the center of this.
The work focuses on improving and simplifying the foundations of the Discord experience at large. This could be streamlining how users customize their settings, to the way they express themselves over text, voice, and video. You’ll be part of a multi-faceted team flexing across surface area ownership, and acting as a guardian on our core foundations.
As a product designer, you'll be involved with the full end-to-end product development process, from brainstorming to launch. You'll use a balance of strategic thinking, product principles, systems design, and strong visual design skills to iterate and innovate on the Discord product. If you're interested in joining a passionate team of designers that are designing features that will be used by millions of people across the world, come join us.
This position will be located in the San Francisco Bay Area (Alameda, Contra Costa, Marin, Napa, San Francisco, San Mateo, Santa Clara, Solano, and Sonoma Counties), or be willing to relocate to the San Francisco Bay Area.
What You'll Be Doing
You will be a design lead without a cross-functional product team, partnering with engineers, product managers and other cross-functional peers to oversee the user experience from idea to market.
You will form part of our growing and “EPAD” Organization that includes Engineering, Product, Analytics and Design functions.
You will create wire-frames, beautiful mockups, amazing prototypes, and help implement your designs to pixel perfection. You will be considered the quality leader within your team, checking all of your work as it it built and ensuring it reflects your vision perfectly.
You will manage your own timelines/deliverables and exercise solid judgment in your own priorities.
You’ll be considered a leader within your immediate team, actively influencing the strategy and scope of your work.
You will be collaborating with designers across organizations in sprints to ensure scalable and consistent user experiences (that isn’t shipping an org chart).
You will proactively present and communicate your designs to organizational leadership, your immediate team and your design peers to garner feedback and build consensus around your concepts. You’ll also routinely share work with the design discipline and executive leadership - acting as the domain expert over your product area.
You will test, learn, and iterate on everything you do alongside product peers.
You will meaningfully use, maintain and routinely contribute components towards our Design System library.
What you should have
5+ years of experience designing modern consumer-focused products, and have been the design lead of multiple product teams.
Highly proficient using Figma and some high-fidelity prototyping tool (ex: Protopie, Framer, Origami, etc). You have a high level of skill at crafting high quality visual designs and have an eye for creating delight in every product experience.
A working understanding and curiosity of AI-assisted design workflows — from ideation and prototyping to generative UI — and the design judgment to know when AI output needs a human hand before it ships.
A portfolio of work on which you were the primary designer contributing to projects for at least both desktop and mobile.
Frequent personal use of Discord, with preference towards those with direct use of the gaming space/experience.
You proactively form ideas and can communicate them with others through varying formats (documents, prototypes, presentations).
You collaboratively guide the vision for the product and achieve it through design explorations, documentation, and presentations.
Ownership mindset with a bias towards action, helping to drive projects and decisions forward. Maintains low ego with a focus on progress and growth.
You have experience working with a design system/library.
The US base salary range for this full-time position is $188,000 to $211,500 + equity + benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role and level. Within the range, individual pay is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Please note that the compensation details listed in US role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include equity, or benefits.
Why Discord?
Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming. Instacart’s Design Systems & Foundations team builds the shared components, tokens, and guidance that power customer, shopper, retailer, and internal tools at scale. We’re looking for a design-first, technically fluent product designer to lead the evolution of our design system as a product—raising quality, usability, scalability, and adoption across multiple product surfaces.
In this role, you’ll partner closely with engineering and design technologists to ensure design-to-code fidelity, integrate guidance directly inside design and development workflows, and shape a durable “source of truth” that can power automation, guardrails, and AI-assisted workflows. You’ll collaborate with an 8-person foundations team and cross-functional partners to unlock velocity and consistency for product teams serving millions of customers.

Own and drive the design system roadmap—prioritizing by product needs, system health, and adoption friction—while aligning stakeholders on a clear, forward-looking vision.
Define and evolve system UX: components, patterns, interaction states, responsive behavior, motion, and accessibility defaults that scale across products and platforms.
Lead token strategy end to end (primitive and semantic), including theming, density, and extensibility, and partner with engineering to maintain consistent component APIs.
Establish strong governance and lifecycle management: contribution standards, quality bars, review processes, versioning, deprecations, and clear migration plans to reduce system drift.
Create implementation-aware specs with edge cases, constraints, usage guidance, and acceptance criteria; collaborate in component-based workflows (e.g., Figma libraries, Storybook) to ensure design-to-code fidelity.
Build design enablement in context—linting rules, templates, and plugin experiences—supported by a structured knowledge model (rules, constraints, examples) that powers automation and AI-assisted support.
Use AI tools intentionally to streamline audits, consistency checks, migrations, and spec generation; contribute to AI-assisted workflows that help teams adopt changes safely.
Measure adoption and impact, identify workflow friction, and execute enablement programs that reduce rework, raise consistency, and accelerate safe system evolution.

6+ years of experience in product design (or equivalent), including shipping and maintaining a design system adopted by multiple product teams.
Portfolio showcasing design systems mastery (components, patterns, tokens, governance) and cross-platform consistency; portfolio link required.
Technical fluency collaborating in component-based workflows (e.g., Figma component libraries and Storybook or equivalent) with a strong understanding of how implementation constraints shape UX.
Hands-on experience with token pipelines and tooling (e.g., CSS variables, semantic token architectures) and writing implementation-aware specs with acceptance criteria.
Proven accessibility competency applied to systems (e.g., WCAG 2.1 AA) with accessible defaults and patterns.
Demonstrated use of AI/automation to improve delivery speed and quality for design systems (e.g., audits, migration planning, consistency checks, spec generation).
Experience driving system adoption through metrics, deprecation/migration programs, and cross-functional enablement.
Bachelor’s degree in Design, HCI, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Experience with AI-assisted coding and design environments (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code) and building Figma plugins or linting/guardrail tooling.
Track record implementing scalable theming, density, and semantic token strategies across multiple products or platforms.
Experience facilitating design sprints, co-creation workshops, or component governance reviews with cross-functional stakeholders.
Data fluency leveraging telemetry, adoption metrics, and experiments to inform system roadmap and deprecation strategies.
Familiarity with versioned monorepos or multi-package design system releases, including change management and migration planning.

Render’s mission is simple: eliminate the tedious work of building software by providing a cloud platform that just works.
We’re evolving from the go-to platform for solo developers into the backbone for fast-scaling teams. As our users’ apps grow from a single service into complex, multi-service architectures, our biggest challenge is keeping it all feeling simple. We need a Product Designer to take that "pile of parts" and turn it into a cohesive system that actually makes sense.
This is a craft-focused IC role, and it's web UI at its most demanding. You'll own the surfaces developers depend on when the clock is ticking and things are breaking. Designing for infrastructure is unique: your screens see the most traffic when the user is most stressed, and "failure" is a first-class state, not an edge case. We’re looking for someone who finds that responsibility energizing.
You’ll join a design team that takes its craft seriously, with weekly critiques and deep cross-functional collaboration. You’ll thrive here if you love untangling complex, messy problems and turning them into accessible, beautiful experiences.

Make a multi-service system legible at a glance. Design the views that let a developer see how their services connect and depend on each other, instead of stitching the picture together one service at a time. This comprehension gap is where design can make a complicated system feel cohesive and friendly.
Design system-level observability. Aggregated logs, metrics, deploys, and events across a whole project, filterable by environment and resource — so a developer can answer "what's going on with my system" in one place. This is high-density information design where hierarchy, scanning speed, and progressive disclosure are the whole game.
Design deployment as a coordinated act. When an application has many services, coordination gets hard. You'll design cross-service deployment and rollback, and a preview model so shipping feels safe at any scale.
Design and consider all product states . You'll own the "unglamorous" moments. Like build errors, failed deploys, and empty states, and turn them into helpful experiences. Since developer tools earn their reputation by how they handle problems, your focus is on guiding the user to success even when things go wrong.
Own a first-run experience worth recommending. The path from signup to first successful deploy is where trust starts. You'll design it so that a developer's first ten minutes make them want to tell someone.
Contribute to where the platform goes next. Alongside the shipping work, you'll bring concept explorations and a strong point of view to a design-led discovery track, shaping the platform's future through a weekly critique cadence with the rest of the team.

5+ years of relevant experience. Whether you’ve worked on developer tools, cloud infrastructure, or another complex, high-stakes product, we care more about your impact than your title.
Exceptional taste and craft. You have an eye for detail that borders on obsessive — typography, spacing, motion, density, interaction feedback. You notice when something is 2px off and it bothers you, and you've shipped work other practitioners admire.
Strong information architecture. You can take a tangle of objects and relationships and make it feel like one obvious thing.
You design the whole journey, not a screen at a time. Your portfolio shows a user carried coherently across every surface a feature touches — entry point to empty state to failure to recovery — not a set of polished screens that don't add up to a system.
Fluent in developer language. You know your way around services, CI/CD, and deployments. You don’t need to have built a cloud platform before, but you’re curious enough to get deep into the weeds of how it works.
Respect for failure states. You believe an error message is an interface, and you design for the user having a bad day, not just the happy path.
Systems fluency. You're comfortable working in and contributing to a design system as the product's surface area grows, extending it rather than fighting it.
Strong product judgment under fast launch velocity. You frame problems well, prioritize ruthlessly, and know which details matter and which can wait.
Clear, direct communication and a genuinely collaborative way of working with product and engineering partners — including sharing a problem space with another designer without needing hard fences between you.

Experience designing complex dashboards, monitoring tools, or console interfaces where data density and high-stakes clarity matter.
You've been on-call, run side projects, or debugged systems in production. You don’t just design for developers; you understand their mental models and the specific frustrations they face.
You’re as excited to design a CLI tool or shape an SDK as you are to build a web dashboard. You’re ready to explore new frontiers like agentic workflows and AI-assisted design, not just standard web UI.

s.h: The T-shape we are hiring for
s.t:
We're looking for a strong T-shaped designer. The three deep vertical spikes are non-negotiable; the horizontal bar is what makes this a Staff role rather than a specialist one.
The depth (your three spikes)
UX strategy: you inform which product problems to solve and why, tie those choices to business outcomes like conversion, retention, or engagement, and set the direction before design work begins.
Systems thinking: you architect modular, sustainable systems and resolve design debt, delivering coherent experience narratives that hold together across flows, brands, and touchpoints.
Craft mastery: you are a master of UI and UX design — layout, hierarchy, motion, typography, micro-interaction — and you hold that bar for an entire cross-functional unit.
The breadth (your bridge)
With that foundation, you move easily beyond design. You dig into research and synthesis with our researchers, and you work through technical constraints with our engineers. Moving comfortably across design, research, and delivery is how you drive innovation and better experiences. Moving comfortably across design, research, and delivery is how you drive innovation and better experiences.
Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

Master-level experience design: Lead design from concept to execution and own the full experience across consumer touchpoints. As a master of UI and UX design, you deliver holistic experience narratives through strong UX strategy and hold the quality bar for your alliance, guiding peers in enhancing their craft.
Systems thinking: Architect intuitive experiences within real technical constraints. Design modular systems that improve efficiency and resolve design debt, creating sustainable, long-term solutions that reach above and beyond individual product boundaries.
UX strategy : Shape product strategy by combining AI analysis with human intuition to develop directions neither could produce alone. Translate insights into compelling narratives, triangulate data, and link design decisions to business and customer needs. Proactively identify strategic product opportunities and anticipate how AI changes user expectations.
Bridge into research: Deeply understand the problem space and drive comprehensive data synthesis, deriving and articulating deep insights that shape both discovery and execution in your domain. Establish AI-assisted synthesis practices that move the team from data to insight faster while maintaining rigor, and mentor others in advanced research and analysis techniques.
AI-native workflow: Push what's possible with AI — using it for complex, multi-step problems, defining what "good enough" means for AI-assisted work in your area, and designing AI-native features (assistants, recommendations, conversational surfaces) that feel helpful and earn user trust. You decide where humans stay in control and where AI can take over.
Craft innovation: Facilitate creative methodologies across teams, establish rapid prototyping practices that help the team explore broadly and converge on validated solutions faster, and continuously evolve the team's toolset. Use motion and interaction as strategic tools to make experiences feel alive and intentional.
Cross-functional influence: Make confident decisions with product leads, engineers, and other stakeholders. Advocate clearly and persistently for the right outcome, and guide teams through trade-offs that balance technical constraints with UX innovation. You are a UX domain expert and thought leader, sought out for guidance and direction.

Experience: Typically 8+ years in product design with a proven track record of delivering high-quality consumer products end-to-end, plus demonstrated impact beyond your own projects — setting standards, resolving ambiguous problems, and elevating those around you.
Craft mastery: Master-level visual and interaction design with an exceptional personal bar. Deep command of hierarchy, motion, micro-interaction, and animation, and the ability to define and articulate quality standards that others adopt.
Systems thinking: Proven ability to design modular, scalable systems, resolve design debt, and deliver coherent experience narratives across flows, brands, and touchpoints.
Cross-disciplinary range: Evidence that you bridge beyond pure design — shaping product strategy with PMs and driving research and synthesis with researchers — and can move fluidly across all threedriving research and synthesis with researchers, and navigating trade-offs with engineers — and can move fluidly across systems, research, and delivery to drive innovation.
AI-native design skills: Fluent, daily use of AI across the design workflow — strategy, insight synthesis, discovery, rapid prototyping, and design-to-code. Fluency with tools like Figma AI, Claude, and Claude Code is expected, along with the judgment to know when AI enhances versus compromises quality.
High agency: You push for the right solution rather than the convenient one, bring conviction to design decisions, and navigate significant ambiguity with strong rationale.
Communication: Exceptional communication and presentation skills, able to translate complex ideas into compelling narratives and secure buy-in upward and across business functions.
Mentorship through influence: You raise the craft bar around you and are sought out as an expert — without needing formal authority to do it.

Since then, we've built the world's largest encrypted email service (Proton Mail) and expanded into Proton VPN, Proton Drive, Proton Pass, and Proton Calendar — tools used by millions globally to protect their freedom, fight censorship, and keep their data safe. We are profitable, independent (no VC control), and selectively hire from the top ~1% of applicants. We work at the intersection of security and simplicity: our products must inspire trust without feeling intimidating, and feel refined without sacrificing clarity.

A World-Changing Company

Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.

The Palantir Design Team is responsible for the human experience of using our software. Our team is growing rapidly, but we're committed to creating a tight-knit team environment that fosters trust, integrity, empathy, and growth. We work together in realizing a shared product vision, and regularly give feedback and critique to each other.

Designing at Palantir is a varied experience. On a given day, you might be: leading a design sprint for your product team; designing a micro-interaction to make a complex analytical task feel simple; and/or advocating for UX consistency by creating flexible, reusable UI components.

As a Product Design intern, your responsibilities look similar to a full-time designer, with the resources, stability, and mentorship of an established tech company. You’ll work on product teams with minimal supervision and own end-to-end execution of real product features. You will work with fellow Designers, Product Managers, Developers, and Forward Deployed Engineers to refine and evolve the quality of Palantir products.
Interaction and visual design . You'll be involved at every stage of design work. You'll help define early product concepts, flesh out the high-level workflow and micro-interactions of a feature, and execute on a crisp and effective visual design. You should have experience designing and prototyping using tools such as Figma.
User research . We frequently do informal user research, and value people who can be flexible with research processes and methodologies to achieve the right outcome. You'll often visit customer offices to interview and learn from the users we serve. You'll pair qualitative methods (e.g. scripted usability tests and contextual inquiry) with quantitative information, like product and usage metrics.
Deliver and communicate designs in close collaboration . We work closely with product and forward deployed engineers to realize our design ideas. You'll treat engineers and product managers as partners and collaborate with them to prototype and build out products.
Awareness of how software interfaces are built. Familiarity with HTML, CSS, Javascript, and Typescript is appreciated. You don't need to be an expert—just fluent enough to collaborate with engineers, and know what's possible with frontend technologies.
What We Value
Excellent collaboration and communication skills with the ability to build great relationships with engineers, PMs, and other stakeholders, and convey and debate design rationale.
High empathy and dedication to the user, striving to understand and empower them.
An iterative design process. You validate your ideas early (with stakeholders and users) and are thoughtful and intentional in seeking and responding to feedback. You move fast, listen, and adapt. You rapidly incorporate feedback, and prioritize collaboration. You are adept at giving and receiving critiques.
Excitement for solving hard, complex problems. You are excited to design for technically complex and data dense interfaces. You thrive in an environment where you can jump into deep subject matter expertise to define simple, approachable, yet still powerful product experiences.
Willingness to learn and make decisions independently, and the ability to ask questions when needed.
What We Require
Active US Security clearance or eligibility and willingness to obtain a US Security clearance.
Must be planning on graduating in 2028. This should be your final internship before graduating.
A portfolio demonstrating at least one software interface design project. If parts of your portfolio are password-protected, please include your portfolio password under 'Additional Questions' when applying.

Own the design direction and the UX/UI pattern system across the apps surface. Navigation, mental models, and UI consistency cut across Apps Meta, Retention, and Design Systems at once, and you hold that cross-cutting direction so three teams ship one coherent experience rather than three versions of it.
Set the quality standard for apps design and hold it as a discipline, not a project. Make the bar visible where teams miss it, and close gaps across teams that you did not personally create. You are accountable for the quality and velocity of all apps design output.
Run planning and discovery for all three teams. Break multi-team, loosely defined problems into clear design direction the designers can run with.
Partner with the Director of Product for Apps and the apps PMs on core initiatives, influencing roadmap and prioritization through design rationale.

Lead the design approach for mobile AI features: how we integrate AI into the apps, the UI, and the navigation around it, so it lands as a native part of the experience.

Raise the ceiling for the other apps designers through critique, shared standards, and patterns they build on. Designers should get better by working alongside you and using what you establish, not only through direct mentorship.

10+ years in product design, with a portfolio of shipped, high-impact mobile work at consumer scale.
Deep native expertise across iOS and Android. Mastery of Apple HIG and Material Design, and the judgment to know when to converge and when to honor platform difference. Hands-on experience with resizability, foldables, and iPad, and a point of view on platform chrome directions like Liquid Glass and Material 3 Expressive.
A track record of raising design quality across a discipline beyond your own projects, through standards you set, critiques you ran, or systems others still use.

As a qualified candidate, you have a track record of leading projects to successful outcomes for users and the business. You are a strong cross-functional partner, a great communicator, and are able to take a solution from idea to implementation. Problem solve, think big, and explore divergent concepts/ideas while understanding how to converge and build iteratively towards your vision.
Plan strategically and think tactically as a partner with product and engineering to define the future of the team.
Influence the shape of the product with research and data while executing design work using high quality wireframes, mockups, user journeys, and cross-platform interactive prototypes.
Advocate for design by sharing your work and presenting cross-functionally, while being able to precisely articulate design rationale.
Inspire the entire team (including your cross-functional) partners by bringing new ideas to the table.
Create a unified, end-to-end experience through close collaboration with team members from across the Product and Marketing Design Teams.

Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.
At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.
A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.
As a Senior Product Designer on the Ads & Brands team, you will shape the future of monetization at Roblox by designing for our core Ads Platform and Tooling. You will build complex, scalable systems that power both sides of our market: helping advertisers launch high-impact campaigns while empowering creators to maximize their earnings.
This role sits at the intersection of deep systems thinking, business impact, and high-craft UX/UI. You will partner with cross-functional teams across Product, Engineering, Research, and Data Science to deliver experiences that balance player delight, creator opportunity, and brand value.

You will play a pivotal role in driving revenue growth, enhancing developer earnings, and transforming multi-faceted ecosystems into intuitive, powerful tools. This role reports to the Senior Manager of Product Design, Ads & Brands.

Define UX strategy and design direction for Roblox’s Ads Platform and tooling
Design and evolve complex, end-to-end experiences that help advertisers launch impactful campaigns and creators maximize their earning potential.
Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Research, and Data Science to translate business goals and user needs into intuitive, effective product experiences.
Use data and strong intuition to identify opportunities, validate design direction, and drive continuous improvement.
Prototype and iterate on complex interactions in Figma, Ai prototyping tool and, when needed, Roblox Studio to bring concepts to life and test ideas quickly.
Collaborate with Foundation Design Systems and other design teams to ensure consistency, scalability, and a high bar for craft across Ads experiences.
Navigate ambiguity and influence product strategy, helping shape solutions across a multi-faceted ecosystem with many interconnected users and stakeholders.
Communicate design strategy, rationale, and tradeoffs clearly to cross-functional partners and senior leadership.
Contribute to design culture through mentorship, critique, and raising the bar for product thinking, systems thinking, and craft.
Understand the unique needs of players, creators, and brands to design experiences that create mutual value across the ecosystem.

8+ years of experience in product design, with a proven track record of shipping consumer-facing, platform, or complex B2B products.
A portfolio demonstrating exceptional interaction and visual design craft, paired with strong product, systems, and strategic thinking.
Experience designing complex workflows, platforms, or tools that serve multiple user types and business needs.
Strong proficiency in Figma, and confidence in prototyping complex, multi-state interactions and systems.
Experience with advertising, commerce, monetization, creator platforms, marketplaces, or other multi-sided ecosystems.
Ability to navigate ambiguity, influence cross-functional decisions, and balance user needs with business goals and technical constraints.
Strong communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to articulate design strategy and rationale to both working teams and senior leadership.
A passion for immersive platforms, gaming, user-generated content, or tools that enable people to create and express themselves.

What We’re Building
Cello helps businesses turn their users into their best acquisition channel. Our product is the easiest way to embed user and partner referrals directly into the products you love to use. With just a few lines of code, a company is set up for hyper growth that runs on autopilot instead of spending money on ads.
Teams at Bolt, Miro, Typeform, VEED, and Descript already run their referral programs on Cello. which is proof that word-of-mouth can be engineered as a real growth channel, not being a nice to have.
We're a small, remote-first team that builds infrastructure that lives in other people's products . That means our bar for craft and attention to detail is exceptionally high.

Our UI has to feel native inside other people's products that we don't control, our components have to hold up wildly across different use cases, and our decisions get scrutinized by the world's best growth, design and engineering teams.

So in addition to caring deeply about how things look and feel, we need people who can think in systems, tracing how a decision plays out across different user segments and across levels of the product.

We're looking for a Senior Product Designer to work closely with our founding designer, product and engineering teams on the core Cello experience. You'll be involved in every aspect of the product design cycle and expected to take ownership of the work end-to-end.
This role is fully remote but your work schedule needs to overlap comfortably with a European work day. We're an async-first culture that values deep focused work, but we still make time to get together in person at regular team off-sites.

Partner directly with our founding designer, product and engineering teams to take projects on our roadmap from rough problem to shipped solution.
Look for opportunities to improve our existing product areas. Sometimes that's a full rethink of how something works, others itʼs fixing smaller quality issues you pick up in the product.
Help define and improve our evolving design system.
Bring our brand to life across marketing, social and launch content.
Design mockups and prototypes in low and high fidelity to communicate ideas and how things might work.
Be part of and contribute to a growing design culture that's still taking shape.
Sweat the details that make embedded UI feel trustworthy.

Solid and proven software design experience
Youʼve ideally designed software for SaaS businesses, but we also love to see range in the type of products youʼve worked on.
Breadth of craft: Youʼre able to comfortably flex across visual design, product thinking, brand, and interaction design.
Systems thinking: you can design components and patterns while thinking about how they fit into the broader system, but you also know when to push past convention and innovate.
Courage to challenge ideas, try new things and push a product direction forward.
Fluency designing in Figma and other prototyping tools. You also experiment regularly with new tooling.
Strong collaboration and communication skills. We have an async work culture.
Comfort working in a fast-paced startup environment, where the stakes are high and priorities can shift quickly. Bonus points if you have both in-house (especially at a startup) and agency experience.
Remote-first, Europe-based (but must be within CET +/-3 hours)

Backed by leading VCs like HV Capital, byFounders, Notion Capital

We are looking for a Product Designer to join our team in Amsterdam, Barcelona, London, Oslo, Bonn or Berlin.

Bakken & Bæck is a design and technology studio that helps companies break new ground. Building digital products, brands and businesses, we help ambitious companies identify, explore and respond to new opportunities. As one team working out of Oslo, Amsterdam, Bonn, Barcelona, and London, we have all the skill-sets needed to help businesses adapt to an increasingly complex world.

We believe the best teams are driven by people with small egos and huge hearts. We strongly believe in flexibility, care deeply about craft, and are at our best working closely together. We want BB to be a place where you can try out new things with the risk of failing, where you can take ownership over your own work, and where there’s a low barrier for coming up with ideas — no matter your job title or discipline.

In this role, you’ll help shape digital products from early exploration through to launch — understanding user and business needs, framing the right problems, and designing thoughtful solutions.

You’ll work as part of a multidisciplinary team with designers, developers, and clients. Together you’ll explore opportunities, test ideas quickly, and translate them into clear product concepts and implementation-ready designs.

We’re looking for someone who enjoys tackling complex problems. Your work will span the full product design process: from early exploration to designing interfaces, prototypes and systems.

We’re particularly interested in designers who are exploring how new tools can improve the way products are designed and built. You should be comfortable experimenting with new workflows, prototyping ideas quickly, and using emerging tools to develop new approaches to your work.

We care less about years of experience and more about curiosity, judgment, and a willingness to learn. You should enjoy collaborating closely with others, sharing your thinking, and evolving ideas together.

Have a strong portfolio demonstrating carefully crafted product design across multiple platforms

A strong ability to turn business requirements, stakeholder goals, and user needs into solutions

Experience designing user flows and interactions for complex digital products

Experience working on every phase of the product design process

Ability to work both independently and as part of collaborative cross-disciplinary teams

Strong communication skills: you can clearly explain and document your process, present your work, and communicate your design decisions

Proficiency in Figma and new AI tools, as well as a curiosity to experiment with new ways of working

What you can look forward to

Independence — BB is an independently-owned studio. We have the freedom to orient towards the projects we believe in, create a culture that is driven by people with small egos and huge hearts, and invest in long-term relationships with partners whose ambitions match our own.

Autonomy — Our culture is built on autonomy, responsibility and mutual trust. Instead of being prescribed a way to do things, we have the freedom to explore and develop our own methods and approaches, and to learn by doing.

Flexibility — We all have different needs when it comes to how we work. We are flexible on working hours, open to workations, and can provide opportunities to relocate to one of our other offices, as long as it doesn't hinder our projects and our team’s progress.

Continuous Learning — We want to invest in your growth. You will receive an annual allowance to invest in a course, class or conference — whatever you need to stay inspired and learn new things.

Doing things together — Collaboration lies at the core of our culture. Whether through trips or team dinners, we prioritise bonding experiences across offices when we can, fostering camaraderie and creativity.

Our offices — We have invested in creating welcoming spaces that provide our teams with what they need. Beyond the day-to-day, we use our offices to host team events, talks and parties.

Relocation support — If you’re moving to join us, we’ll help make the transition as smooth as possible with visa sponsorship and guidance, a travel budget, and thoughtful settling-in support — from housing tips and language classes to a buddy, welcome bundle, and a team outing to help you feel at home.

The relocation package varies somewhat by location. Because we want our team members to be actively involved in our offices, we do not consider remote applicants, but we’re happy to support relocation to come join us!

Spacelift is the infrastructure orchestration platform built for the modern software era, managing the full lifecycle for both traditional IaC and AI-accelerated infrastructure. It integrates with Terraform, OpenTofu, CloudFormation, Pulumi, and Ansible in a single governed workflow so you deliver secure, compliant infrastructure at scale.

Developer self-service, Golden Paths with guardrails, an OPA policy engine, and drift detection accelerate developer velocity while maintaining control. Spacelift Intelligence adds AI-powered provisioning and diagnostics across traditional and AI-driven workflows.

Spacelift was founded in 2020 by long-time DevOps practitioner Marcin Wyszynski and successful entrepreneur Pawel Hytry and has raised $82.3M in funding over four rounds from top venture capital firms including Insight Partners, Blossom Capital, Hoxton Ventures, Inovo Venture partners and Five Elms Capital.

We are hiring a Product Designer with 2 to 5 years of experience to carry well-scoped, ongoing work on a mature product under senior review, so the senior designers can focus on the new bet.

This is deliberately the first seat below Senior on the team: a place to do real craft on a real product, with strong people to learn from, and a clear path toward Senior. What you'll do:
Own well-scoped, ongoing design work on a mature product area (likely Deploy): iterations, improvements, edge cases, polish, and consistency work, with review and direction from a Senior or Staff Designer.
Turn defined problems into clear, production-ready interface designs. Strong fundamentals in interaction design, information architecture, and visual design. Share examples of this work through a portfolio or concrete work samples during the process.
Contribute to research alongside a senior teammate. Run focused user interviews and usability checks. Synthesize findings with support.
Use the design system fluently. Reuse what is there, flag gaps when a pattern is missing. Owning or extending the system is not your job here; that sits with the seniors.
Partner with engineering and PM through implementation. Pair on edge cases. Communicate decisions with reasoning, not preference.
Contribute design assets to launches and releases (in-product onboarding, release-notes visuals, announcement surfaces) with guidance.
Build technical fluency. Be curious about DevOps, IaC, and the dense, technical workflows our users live in, even when it is new to you.

2 to 5 years of product design experience, ideally on B2B, technical, or developer-facing products.
Solid fundamentals in interaction design, information architecture, and visual design.
Fluency in Figma and modern design system practice.
A portfolio or work samples with concrete examples we can review, showing shipped product work, design process, interaction decisions, and visual craft. Applications without examples or a portfolio will not be considered.
Reliable on ongoing, iterative work. You finish things, you sweat the details, and you keep quality consistent across a lot of small surfaces.
Clear written and verbal communicator. You can explain a design decision in a couple of sentences.
Open to critique and direction. You want to work under senior designers and get better fast.
Curiosity about technical users and technical conversations.
Comfortable using AI tools in your design workflow (ideation, exploration, basic automation) and curious about where they help. We use them daily and expect you to.
Fluent English (B2+), based in Europe.

Background or coursework in DevOps tools, infrastructure, observability, CI/CD, or developer products.
Experience contributing to (not owning) a design system and familiarity with design tokens.
Familiarity with HTML/CSS or basic prototyping in code.
Exposure to Working Backwards or other artifact-driven product practices.

You'll partner closely with Product, Engineering, Research, Data, and Content Design to solve complex customer problems, shape product direction, and deliver elegant, intuitive experiences from concept through launch. Transform ambiguous opportunities into elegant, intuitive experiences that simplify financial decision-making for millions of members.

Deep expertise with Figma and modern prototyping tools, with a strong understanding of design systems and scalable interaction patterns.
Experience using customer research, experimentation, and product metrics to inform design decisions and iterate on solutions.

How we're different
We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles.

We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

You will work alongside an existing designer and with product, engineering, and data staff.
This is a hands-on role and a senior one. You are here to do the design work, and you will own how design gets done on this program: the research approach, the patterns, and the standard the work is held to. You'll operate as a senior IC: setting direction, influencing roadmap decisions (not just contributing), shaping bets with Product and Engineering leaders, and raising the bar on how we think about enterprise design problems.

Own the Enterprise surface end-to-end, from problem framing to shipped outcomes and iteration - often dealing with ambiguity. You'll reach out to the right stakeholders, get the right eyes in the room, and make decisions independently.
Design complex governance and compliance systems that give admins, legal teams, and compliance officers genuine control and transparency. Examples include:
Permission models and role hierarchies that scale across thousands of creators without collapsing into chaos.
Audit log experiences that make compliance auditable - not just for the system, but for the humans who need to understand what happened.
Workspace setup and identity workflows that integrate with real enterprise infrastructure (SSO, SCIM, MCP).
License and billing models that admins can actually understand and manage at scale.
Analytics and reporting that tell admins whether their deployment is working as intended.
Work with technical constraints and possibilities . You'll develop fluency in APIs, widget architectures, developer hub patterns, and how backend systems shape what's actually achievable in the UX. You're not designing in isolation from engineering - you're designing in partnership with it.

Senior Product Designer II - Productivity
Job Description

s.h: Our mission is to protect life.
s.t:
We’re out to make the world a safer place by solving big problems and taking on the public safety challenges of our time.

From our company's inception building the TASER device to a full suite of hardware and software solutions, we are focused on providing police agencies with state-of-the-art devices and services they need to successfully serve and protect us.

In the next few years, we're going to eliminate the burden of paperwork in policing, so officers can increase the time they spend building relationships and serving in their communities. We’ll put video at the heart of police records so our justice system can get to the truth faster.

And we won't stop innovating until the bullet is rendered obsolete.
It’s a big mission, but it’s one we’ll pursue relentlessly every single day.

Officers can spend up to a third of their shift staring at a computer screen, populating boxes and filling out forms. While essential, there is a direct trade-off – when an officer is tied up on a computer, they aren't actively patrolling or engaging with their communities.
Axon Records is our state-of-the-art records management system. Axon Records re-imagines the way officers write reports in the field to how detectives help prosecute crime. Police reports come to life with video at the heart of the record to tell the full story. By leveraging AI and Machine Learning towards data, we can support new strategies for how officers get paperwork done accurately while increasing their safety and ability to serve their community more effectively.
We believe that happy teams take good care of their customers, so we foster a friendly, open, introspective team culture that encourages everyone to speak their mind and deliberately avoids red tape, unnecessary rituals, politics, and jerks.
We believe we can only succeed if we deeply understand our customers and get to know them personally. We spend a lot of time with law enforcement officers to learn about their needs, watch their experience and see the real impact of our work. Your first ride-along with a patrol officer will forever change your perception of what the job is, and what the city is like.

Location: This role is based out of Seattle, Washington and follows a hybrid schedule. We rely on in-person collaboration and ask that team members work onsite Tuesdays through Fridays, with the flexibility to work remotely on Mondays, unless there is an approved workplace accommodation. We believe that connection fuels innovation, and our in-office culture is designed to foster meaningful teamwork, mentorship, and shared success.
Reports to: Design Manager
Direct Reports: none
Own Key Product Areas : Take ownership of specific Axon Records features. Design and deliver user-centric solutions that align with product goals and enhance the overall user experience.
Contribute to Product Strategy : Work closely with Product Management to influence product direction and prioritize investments.
Execute End-to-End Design Process : Lead the design process for these product areas—from research and discovery through prototyping, testing, and final implementation—ensuring high-quality outcomes.
Conduct User Research : Collaborate with Product Managers to plan and execute user research to uncover insights and inform design decisions. Leverage user research and data to inform design decisions and iterate on solutions based on feedback.
Leverage AI Thoughtfully: Design experiences that responsibly integrate AI by clearly communicating when and how AI is being used, ensuring transparency, trust, and usability.
Collaborate Across Teams : Work with a global team of PMs, engineers, and designers, navigating time zone differences with flexibility and clear communication.
Design for Multi-Modal Experiences : Focus on creating seamless, user-friendly solutions across mobile and desktop platforms that address diverse user needs.
Simplify Complexity : Turn complex workflows into intuitive, scalable designs that are easy to understand and use.
Communicate Effectively : Present design concepts and product ideas clearly to stakeholders to build alignment and support.

Experience in Product Design : 7+ years of product design experience, including at least 4 years leading major design initiatives.
Enterprise Design Expertise : 3+ years of experience researching, designing, and shipping enterprise software or complex consumer workflows (beyond simple consumer applications).
User-Centered Design Mastery : Proven ability to apply user-centered design processes and methodologies to product definition, design, and development. Hands-on experience across all stages of the design process, including research, sketches, wireframes, high-fidelity mockups, prototyping, and usability testing.
Collaborative Spirit : A passion for early product definition as well as collaborating with cross-functional teams, including Product Management and Engineering, to bring designs to life.
Prototyping and Conceptual Skills : Strong conceptual abilities with a proven track record of rapidly prototyping and iterating on designs to communicate ideas effectively.
Communication Excellence : Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain design decisions clearly to diverse audiences.
Tool Proficiency : Highly skilled in the latest design tools and adaptable to new ones. Familiarity with Figma is preferred, as well as enthusiasm for exploring emerging design technologies with Cursor, Claude, and Gemini.
Versatile Team Player : Capable of working independently and thriving in a collaborative team environment. Comfortable leading initiatives or supporting others, depending on the context.
Curiosity and Adventure : A boundless curiosity and eagerness to explore new challenges and opportunities in design.
Portfolio of Excellence : A portfolio showcasing your work, available for review.
Education : Bachelor’s degree in Interaction Design, Graphic Design, Industrial Design, HCI, or a related field.
