This role involves deeply understanding our user personas (Tenant, Landlord, Maintenance Contractor, Dwelly Agent) and designing for both the customer-facing portals and the operational tools our agents use every day.
Given the early stage of the business, our current products are hyper-functional but quite basic — an "MVP" that prioritises getting the job done across all domains.

You'll work closely with product and engineering to take these to the next level: bringing clarity, usability, and craft to data-dense, workflow-heavy internal tools, and building genuinely good experiences for tenants and landlords.

You'll also help establish the basic building blocks of design at Dwelly — a shared design system, patterns, and a lightweight design process — from the ground up.
Our current development team is a team of 5, a few analysts, and one product designer. You'll join a small, fast-moving product team and have an outsized impact on how the whole product looks, feels, and works.

1. User Research & Insights
Work with product to understand user pain points across all personas — tenants, landlords, maintenance contractors, and internal agents.
Turn qualitative and quantitative insights into design decisions.
Act as an advocate for usability and the end user within the company.
2. End-to-End Product Design
Design flows, wireframes, and high-fidelity UIs for both customer-facing products (tenant and landlord portals) and internal back-office tools.
Design for data-dense, workflow-heavy operational products where clarity and efficiency matter more than decoration.
Own the design process from concept and prototyping through to polished, build-ready specs, and iterate after launch.
3. Design Across the Product Suite
Bring consistency and quality across Tenant Find, Property Management, Payments, and the communications/portal layer.
Partner closely with engineers and product managers to translate requirements into shippable design, balancing craft with speed and technical feasibility.
4. Design System & Process Building
Establish and maintain a shared design system, component library, and reusable patterns.
Introduce lightweight design workflows, documentation, and review/handoff practices suited to an early-stage team.

Experience: 5+ years in product design, with a strong portfolio spanning both complex/operational tools and consumer-facing products. Comfortable in early-stage, low-structure environments as well as more structured, product-led settings.
Skills: Strong interaction and visual design skills; systems thinking; exceptional attention to detail; able to design for complexity and make it feel simple. Excellent communication and collaboration skills across product and engineering.
In step with recent technology advancements: can prototype and ship designs quickly and independently with the help of AI.

Experience designing operational, back-office, or B2B tools where efficiency and workflow are central — ideally in tech-enabled or operational businesses.
Experience building or contributing to a design system from scratch.
Strong sense of ownership, a "get things done" attitude, and excellent attention to detail.

Competitive salary with the potential for equity options based on performance, recognising exceptional contributions to our integration success.
What is it like being a Dwell-er?
Feel free to check out Dwelly Core Principles . That’s about what we believe in, how we operate and make decisions.
What we offer is not a fancy office or a static workplace. Instead, this is solving one of worlds’ most complex problems in the largest consumer industry in the world (residential rentals), to improve the experience for >30% of households (>5M in the UK, and >100M including EU and US) that live in rental homes.
This is about disrupting the largest, most antiquated industry in the world, with one of the strongest operational and technical teams that exist in the UK and the EU. We work hard, and we shoot for extremely ambitious results. But we want people to be proud of what they’ve built and be able to look back and say one day “hell yeah, that was me that did it all”.
Customer obsession rather than competitive focus
Passion for invention
Operational excellence
Long-term thinking

s.h: Your Mission This is a company built for growth.
s.t:
When you join exmox, you’re stepping onto a global, highly competitive playing field, solving real problems in environments that push you beyond your comfort zone.
We build high-performing consumer products across multiple brands in one of the most competitive industries there is: mobile gaming. You will be part of a company on a path of hyper-growth, spearheading one of the largest innovations in the mobile gaming industry, rewarded user acquisition.
As a Senior Product Designer - UI Focus (f/m/x) at exmox, you'll join our product design team to shape the user interface and experience of our mobile-first B2C product, impacting millions of users. You'll own features from concept to handoff and create polished, engaging, habit-forming interfaces.

This role is about designing experiences that perform. You’ll work at the intersection of user behavior, data, and business goals, shaping flows that drive engagement and revenue. Your work reaches over 25 million users and feeds directly into experimentation and iteration, letting you see the real impact of your decisions.

At exmox, we're also embracing AI as part of how we work, not just what we build. We use AI tools to work smarter, cut down on repetitive tasks and spend our time where it actually moves the needle. If that mindset speaks to you, you'll fit right in.
Our product design team is growing in maturity, and you’ll play a key role in shaping how design works at exmox. If you want high impact, real ownership, and a product at scale, we want to hear from you.
What You’ll Own: Feature ownership: Own and design new features from concept through final handoff.
UI design: Design visually engaging and highly polished interfaces for our B2C mobile app.
Visual assets: Create illustrations, icons, and other graphical assets to support your designs.
Developer handoff: Deliver production-ready assets, specifications, prototypes, and documentation to engineering teams.
Design system: Build, maintain, and contribute to our evolving design system.
Design quality: Conduct design reviews to ensure implementations match the intended designs.
Research collaboration: Work closely with UX research and data teams to evaluate and improve your designs.
Iteration & feedback: Gather feedback and continuously refine and improve your work.
What’s in it for you as a designer? Impact : Your work directly influences a product used by millions. You’ll see the effect of your design decisions on business KPIs and learn how to create value through design.
Data-driven culture : Data sits at the core of every decision we make. You’ll design, test, and iterate based on real user insights and performance metrics.
Large global user base : You’ll design for a product with over 25 million users worldwide, operating at true scale.
Growing design maturity : Our product design team is on a journey to elevate design maturity at exmox, and you’ll actively shape and contribute to that evolution.
Cross-functional design team : You’ll collaborate within a dedicated design team including Product designers, UI Designers, and UX Researcher.
What You Bring Portfolio: A portfolio showcasing outstanding mobile UI craft and visual design.
Professional experience: 5+ years of experience working in product teams as a UI, UI/UX, or Product Designer.
Consumer product design: Experience designing habit-forming, engaging, consumer-facing interfaces.
Industry background: Experience in marketing, gaming, or other B2C-heavy industries is a plus.
Hard Skills: Design tools: Strong proficiency in Figma.
Motion & interaction design: Expertise in motion design, animation, and transitions to craft dynamic interfaces.
Visual asset creation: Expertise in creating illustrations, iconography, and other visual assets.
Design systems: Expertise in designing, shipping, and maintaining design systems.
Multi-brand products: Experience with multi-brand, white-label products and theming systems.
Brand identity: Experience in defining, designing, and documenting brand identities.
Copywriting: Experience in copywriting, including defining tone, voice, and messaging.
Accessibility & usability: Strong knowledge of accessibility and usability principles.
Frontend awareness: Understanding of front-end technologies and implementation constraints.
Language skills: Fluency in English; German is a plus.
Soft Skills: Ownership : You take full responsibility for your work, drive initiatives forward, align stakeholders, and ensure meaningful value delivery.
Proactiveness : You anticipate challenges, identify opportunities, and take initiative without waiting for direction.
Prioritisation : You focus on what matters most, balance speed and quality, and manage your workload effectively in a fast-paced environment.
Feedback mindset : You give constructive feedback thoughtfully and embrace feedback as an essential part of iteration and growth, comfortably navigating multiple refinement cycles.
Creative thinking : You explore a wide range of ideas and solutions from safe bets to bold, out-of-the-box concepts to achieve the most impactful outcome.
How We Win Speed is the feature. Speed beats rocket science. We move fast, test fast, and multiply our pace with AI, because action creates information and small wins compound. A fast failure is a lesson we learn from, a slow one is a problem we can't afford.
Focus on the essential. Done is better than perfect. We stay focused on what actually moves us forward and protect people's time from anything that doesn't. We're direct in how we communicate too, no rambling, no unnecessary detail.
See it. Own it. Solve it. The first to see it is best placed to fix it. We're not a place for comfort, we're a place for doers. "Not my job" isn't in our vocabulary, if you spot something, you help make sure it gets solved.
Respect others. Trust multiplies. Respect is non-negotiable. We disagree with ideas, never with people. Trust here is built the same way it is anywhere, through consistency, a thank you, a moment of listening, and owning your mistakes.
Perks that help you focus on what matters. Transport subsidy, learning budget, wellness and gym, workation, bi-weekly team lunches, and more. The perks are great, but the real reason people join and stay is the challenge, the ownership, and the drive to win together.
Please note: this is not a remote only position, we offer you a flexible hybrid model here in Hamburg, Germany - working from home on Mondays & Fridays, coming to the office on Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday!

About Calm
Calm is the leading mental health brand on a mission to make the world happier and healthier.

Known for its flagship consumer app—ranked #1 in its category with over 180 million downloads and availability in ten languages across 190 countries—Calm helps people sleep better, stress less, and live more mindfully through content and tools from experts and beloved celebrity voices.

Building on this foundation, Calm has created a broader portfolio including evidence-based solutions like Calm Health , offered through employers, health plans and providers, designed to expand access to mental health and sleep support, boost benefits engagement, and drive positive health outcomes.

Today, Calm supports more than 3,500 organizations and reaches over 42 million covered lives through Calm Health. Calm has been recognized as a TIME100 Most Influential Company and one of Fast Company’s Brands That Matter . Learn more at calm.com .
What We Do
At Calm we believe in making relaxation, better sleep, and mindfulness accessible to the entire world, and we hope you will help us achieve our mission. The Product & Design team is responsible for delivering Calm to our customers, ensuring that it is easy to use, supports their goals, and maintains a high level of quality across web, iOS, Android platforms.
As a Senior Product Designer on our Consumer team, you'll shape experiences used by tens of millions of people to sleep better, stress less, and live more mindfully. People often reach for Calm in their most vulnerable moments, so the craft of what we make (how it looks, moves, and feels) matters enormously.
This is a builder's role in the truest sense: you'll use AI and modern prototyping tools to move from insight to interactive prototype to shipped experience, not as a shortcut on quality, but to spend less time producing and more time on the judgment and detail that make an experience great. When anyone can generate a hundred screens in an afternoon, taste and judgment are the differentiators!
The heart of this role is balancing velocity and craft in service of making our users healthier and happier, and building intuitive, engaging and impactful experiences that drive acquisition, engagement and retention.

You'll partner closely with Product Management, Engineering, Data Science, and Marketing, and set the standard for craft across iOS, Android, and web. You will be a thought leader in design, helping to establish best practices and setting the bar for exceptional product design at Calm.

Own end-to-end product design initiatives that cover the whole product experience (visual, interaction, motion, brand integration), to create thoughtful, high-quality user-centered mobile experiences.
Prototype quickly in Figma and with AI and low-code tools like Replit, Lovable, and Claude, so you can get real, testable ideas in front of people early.
Present your design work clearly and persuasively to cross-functional stakeholders (including senior leadership), give and take feedback well, anchoring your rationale to both user needs and business goals.
Maintain strong attention to detail and collaboration through engineering implementation (build and QA) and post launch-iterations, to ensure high-quality execution.
Use data and drive research to inform the experiences you build, and leverage performance insights to evolve your approach.
Champion system-level thinking (improving how the team works and evolving Calm's design system) so the whole team works faster and smarter.
Balance multiple projects in a fast-paced environment while maintaining high standards of execution.

Experienced Product Designer: 7+ years of experience in UX and UI design with 5+ within consumer mobile and web applications.
AI-native and tooling-fluent: Highly proficient in Figma for design, and already using AI and low-code tools (Replit, Lovable, Claude) to prototype and move fast, with the judgment to know when the output is good enough and when it isn't.
Technical agility: Comfortable shipping small code changes without engineering support, bridging the gap between design and engineering by personally shipping copy and UI polish directly.
A builder: Biased toward shipping and iterating over perfect plans. You'd rather put a working prototype in front of people than write a doc about one.
Data- and research-informed: You fold both qualitative and quantitative insight into your design decisions, and you measure whether the work landed.
A strong collaborator: A low-ego, trusted partner to Product, Research, and Engineering who makes the people around them better and helps sharpen how the team works.
High craft standards: A strong advocate for accessibility, consistency, visual storytelling, brand integration, and motion design to create engaging user experiences, while still maintaining velocity.
A clear communicator: You present your thinking persuasively to stakeholders and senior leadership, give and take feedback well, and champion an experience while staying open to being wrong.

Experience with conversational or AI-native UX.
Experience working at multiple organizations, ideally including time at a consumer product in a fast-paced startup environment.
A strong portfolio demonstrating your ability to design and ship beautiful, functional, and user-friendly experiences.
Comfort shipping small copy and UI changes directly in code, without engineering support.
A passion for Calm's mission and a point of view on how digital products can support mental health.

7+ years in UX/UI design with 5+ within consumer mobile (and web) applications.
Proven experience driving user testing and research.
Strong foundation in interaction design, visual design, and usability best practices.
Experience designing and shipping mobile applications at scale.
Hands-on proficiency in Figma and modern AI/prototyping tools.
Ability to work independently while contributing to a larger design vision and strategy.

What success looks like
You can take an ambiguous problem and drive it from framing to shipped solution, proactively aligning with the UX Lead at key decision moments
You reduce rework by surfacing risks early and designing complete end-to-end flows, including edge cases and states, not just happy paths
You keep consistency across squads by defaulting to existing patterns and contributing improvements
You collaborate smoothly with engineers and Product Owners, keeping decisions crisp and documented
You follow through after release, validating outcomes and feeding learnings back into future work

Insight-Led Product Development
Drive problem framing with Product Owners, including primary users, jobs to be done, constraints, assumptions, and risks
Plan and run lightweight research activities when needed, such as quick interviews, concept checks, and usability tests
Synthesize findings into clear recommendations that influence solution direction
Define success signals during Discovery and support evaluation after release by comparing outcomes to those signals
Rapid Concepting and Holistic Experience Design
Generate multiple solution directions quickly and articulate tradeoffs in plain language
Prototype at the right fidelity, starting with quick and lightweight concepts, to align stakeholders and reduce risk before build
Deliver end-to-end flows that include key states and edge cases
Ensure usability best practices are applied consistently across the experience
Design System-Led Craft
Design polished high-fidelity UI aligned with brand guidelines and our Design System
Default to existing patterns and reuse components consistently across squads
When a clear gap exists, document it with variants, states, and usage guidance and raise it with the UX Lead for review before extending the system
Ensure responsive behavior and accessibility basics are included from the start
Embedded Engineering Partnership
Collaborate early with engineers on feasibility, scope, and technical constraints before designs are considered final
Specify behaviors precisely, including interactions, content requirements, states, and responsive rules
Keep handoff current during build and communicate changes clearly to the rest of the squad
Support implementation by answering questions quickly and helping unblock delivery
Quality Ownership from Design to Release
Verify the built experience across key screens, browsers, and breakpoints
Write clean bug reports with clear repro steps and expected versus actual behavior, including screenshots
Capture learnings post-release and feed improvements back into patterns and future work

3 to 5 years of Product Design experience, including owning work from Discovery through Delivery
Portfolio demonstrating problem framing, research-informed decisions, multiple options explored, and at least one end-to-end shipped workflow
Strong knowledge of Design Systems, including applying and evolving component libraries, documenting usage guidelines, and collaborating on governance so patterns stay consistent across squads
Strong proficiency in Figma, including component creation, variants, auto layout, and clean file structure
Comfort working alongside AI-assisted design and development workflows, including tools like Claude, and an understanding of how design decisions are consumed by AI agents in the build process
Proven ability to operate with ambiguity, take ownership, and deliver while proactively aligning with the UX Lead at key milestones
Familiarity with Mixpanel or similar analytics tools, and ability to combine quantitative signals with qualitative research insights to guide decisions
Strong collaboration and communication skills with Product and Engineering
High attention to detail and strong follow-through to ensure quality in the shipped experience

Understanding of communications and PR agency workflows, and how firms like Edelman operate across clients, teams, and delivery models

Decagon is the leading conversational AI platform empowering every brand to deliver concierge customer experiences.

Decagon is the leading conversational AI platform, empowering every brand to deliver concierge customer experiences. About Halter
At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences.

Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance.

Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard.
We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund , Bessemer Venture Partners , BOND, DCVC , Blackbird , Promus Ventures , Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures .
To find out more, visit our LinkedIn & Instagram .

How do you represent a living, literally breathing farm in an app and then let someone control it from their pocket?
With Halter's solar-powered collars and software, farmers can fence and shift cattle, manage their pasture and the environment more effectively and monitor animal health, all from one app in real time. There is no reference for this, no pattern library, no interaction models to borrow from. We are inventing them.
A farm is alive and always moving: animals, pasture, weather, all changing by the minute. Our job is to turn that into something a farmer can read at a glance and act on with total confidence. The stakes are physical and the visual and interaction bar is extremely high, this is a farmer's entire farm in their pocket, it should feel like it. Beautifully crafted and a joy to use, every day, for years.
We're looking for a Staff Product Designer to lead the design of a significant area of the product experience at Halter. You'll take on some of our hardest problems and help set the bar for what Halter's product experience should feel like.
Design at Halter is high agency and high impact. We help define what we should build and why, we spend real time with farmers, ranchers and graziers in the field, and we shape where Halter goes next.
This role is based in our Auckland, New Zealand HQ, relocation and visa assistance is provided.

Set, own and advance our design foundations across mobile and web.
Set the standard for craft at Halter, and make that standard usable through principles, guidance and worked examples that raise the quality of what every team ships.
Shape the technical architecture and system structure alongside engineers.
Treat the system as a product with real customers. Set its direction, prioritise what to build next based on what designers and engineers actually need.
Give teams a clear point of view on which pattern to reach for and why.
Turn our field conditions into standards the system carries by default: legibility, target sizes, clarity at a glance.
Work alongside teams to spot what's working across new product surfaces and promote it into documented, reusable foundations. Decide what earns the right to be a pattern and what's better left a considered one-off.
Raise the craft of the designers around you through feedback, reviews and mentorship, and champion the system across product, engineering and design leadership.

8+ years designing digital products, with significant time spent designing and building design systems at scale.
Exceptional visual craft and command of typography, layout, spacing, colour, accessibility, interaction and motion design.
Proven experience shipping a design system with engineers. You know how tokens and component libraries are structured in code, and you've built and maintained the Figma to code connection.
A portfolio showing both foundational systems work, and concrete high-craft experiences built with it.
Not just taste, but conviction and the language to make your judgment explicit, teachable and useful to others.
A track record of coaching other designers and raising quality around you, and the presence to build alignment and defend an opinionated decision.

Delicious snacks and drinks are available for your daily flow.
Healthy body, healthy mind. We're partnered with Southern Cross Health Insurance to support your well-being.
We offer 6 months of fully paid parental leave for primary caregivers, 4 weeks of fully paid secondary caregiver leave and many other parental benefits that support you and your family.
Our personal growth is important. Halter offers an annual $1000 self-development budget to be used for anything that fuels personal growth.
Our time to recharge is valued, we're offered wellness leave and unlimited paid annual leave.
Importantly, we offer an inclusive and attractive remuneration package made up of salary, benefits and an employee stock ownership plan.
Our Office First Approach
Humans are wired for connection. Being office first is a core pillar of our culture because in-person connections drive your growth, learning, impact, and relationships. Strong relationships make it easier to disagree, give feedback, and do meaningful work together.
We're office first, not office only. Working from the office is our default, but we flex when needed. We have a high-trust culture where everyone is trusted to do what's best for Halter.
Our office vibe is special, the high energy and spectacular people make work enjoyable. Your growth and impact are unlimited here, coming from solving problems, innovating, and constantly learning from each other.
Join our team
Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement.

If you think you have what it takes but don’t necessarily tick every requirement on this job description, please still get in touch and apply to Halter. We’d love to chat to see if you’ll be an epic fit!
If this opportunity sounds like you, please apply below by sending through your cover letter explaining why you’re excited about this role and working at Halter, along with your CV, and we’ll be in touch!
Please also feel free to check out the careers page for more information on working at Halter and don't forget to follow us on LinkedIn & Instagram .

s.h: Why our team loves working at Halter
s.t:
Work that genuinely matters. Every now and again a company comes along that transforms an entire industry and leaves the world in a better place. Our team gets to be part of something truly meaningful, helping farmers improve their livelihoods, spend more time with their families, and build more sustainable operations.
Spectacular people solving hard problems. Our culture is designed for talented people to do work that changes lives. The team is filled with diverse, kind, and driven people who push each other to do their best work. You'll be thrown into the deep end, tackling complex challenges and building something tangible that solves real problems.

Senior Product Designer
This is a hybrid role to our Toronto HelloFresh Headquarters
HelloFresh is seeking a Senior Product Designer to join our Growth UX team , shaping how prospective and returning customers discover, evaluate, and choose HelloFresh across our portfolio of brands.
As a Senior-level individual contributor, you’ll lead complex, high-impact growth challenges across acquisition, conversion, checkout, reactivation, and new purchase experiences. You’ll combine strong product design craft with experimentation, systems thinking, and commercial awareness to create experiences that are intuitive, relevant, and effective.
This is a strategic and hands-on role. You’ll contribute to the future direction of our growth experiences while continuously identifying opportunities to improve what exists today. You’ll work in an AI-native design environment , using AI throughout the design lifecycle to accelerate discovery, synthesis, prototyping, and execution — while applying strong judgment around where AI improves the quality of the customer experience.
At Senior level, we expect you to independently lead ambiguous product challenges, influence product direction, and contribute patterns and practices that make the broader team stronger. You’ll remain deeply involved in the craft, using the quality of your thinking, design, and collaboration to bring others along.

Lead high-impact Growth experiences
Own the end-to-end design of critical growth journeys across acquisition, conversion, checkout, payment, reactivation, and emerging purchase models.
Translate complex customer and business problems into experiences that clearly communicate value, reduce friction, and help customers confidently make decisions.
Balance immediate conversion opportunities with the longer-term customer experience, considering not only whether customers convert, but whether we are setting them up for meaningful engagement and retention.
Shape product direction
Partner with Product, Engineering, Data, Research, Marketing, and Content Design to identify opportunities across the customer journey.
Connect customer needs, behavioural insights, commercial goals, and emerging technology to develop strong product directions.
Move comfortably between contributing to longer-term vision and delivering tactical improvements that generate measurable impact today.
Bring a strong design perspective to your product area while remaining open to evidence, experimentation, and the expertise of your partners.
Drive experimentation and validated learning
Use quantitative and qualitative insights to identify opportunities, develop hypotheses, and design high-impact experiments.
Partner closely with Product and Data to understand performance across the funnel and translate learnings into actionable design improvements.
Look beyond the outcome of individual A/B tests to identify patterns and insights that can inform future product and design decisions.
Help teams balance experimentation velocity with customer comprehension, trust, and experience quality.
Work AI-natively
Integrate AI into your day-to-day design practice, from exploration, research synthesis, and ideation through rapid prototyping and design-to-code workflows.
Use tools such as Claude & Claude Code, Gemini, Figma AI, and emerging technologies to shorten the distance between an idea and something customers can experience and validate.
Explore opportunities for AI-native customer experiences, including personalization, recommendations, adaptive journeys, and conversational interactions.
Apply strong design judgment to AI-generated outputs, understanding when AI accelerates quality and when human craft, intuition, and critical thinking matter most.
Raise the bar for design craft
Create polished, intuitive experiences with strong attention to visual hierarchy, interaction design, motion, micro-interactions, content, and overall usability.
Identify opportunities to improve the quality and coherence of the Growth experiences you work on.
Contribute patterns, practices, and examples that help other designers deliver stronger work.
Give and seek thoughtful critique, using feedback to continuously strengthen the work.
Design systems, not just screens
Think across journeys rather than individual touchpoints, identifying opportunities to create reusable patterns and modular experiences that can scale across markets, brands, customer types, and purchase models.
Partner with our design system teams while contributing to Growth-specific patterns where needed.
Help reduce design debt and fragmentation by creating solutions that make future experimentation faster without sacrificing relevance or quality.
Lead through collaboration
Bring strong perspectives and clear rationale to complex product decisions.
Guide cross-functional partners through ambiguity and trade-offs, advocating for customer-centred solutions while understanding commercial and technical constraints.
Build alignment through clear communication, evidence, and strong design rationale rather than formal authority.
Support other designers through critique, collaboration, and sharing new practices and approaches.

Senior-level product design experience
Typically 4-6+ years of product design experience , although we care more about the scope, complexity, and impact of your work than years alone.
A strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end ownership of complex consumer experiences, from understanding the problem through shipped outcomes and learning.
Experience independently navigating ambiguous problems, making sound design decisions, and influencing product direction within your area.
Growth and experimentation expertise
Strong experience designing B2C growth, e-commerce, subscription, marketplace, or other transaction-driven experiences.
You understand experimentation deeply and can translate behavioural data, customer insights, and business metrics into meaningful design opportunities.
You know how to optimize for conversion without losing sight of trust, comprehension, customer value, and longer-term engagement.
Exceptional product design craft
Strong expertise across interaction and visual design, including hierarchy, information architecture, responsive behaviour, motion, and micro-interactions.
You can take complex experiences and make them feel simple, and can articulate what separates a functional experience from a great one.
You care about the details while understanding when speed, learning, and iteration matter more than perfection.
AI-native design fluency
AI is already part of how you work, not something you are waiting to adopt.
You regularly use AI across multiple stages of your design process, whether that’s discovery, synthesis, ideation, prototyping, or execution.
You’re comfortable experimenting with tools such as Figma AI, Claude, Claude Code, Gemini, or similar emerging technologies.
You’re interested not only in using AI to work faster, but in understanding how it changes what we can design for customers.
Systems thinking
You naturally look beyond the individual screen or experiment to understand how experiences connect.

Peloton is seeking a Senior Product Designer to help define the customer experience on the Web Acquisition team. This role is focused on designing UX/UI for the consumer acquisition experience across the onepeloton.com website.

The candidate must think in non-linear terms: capturing interactions, edge-cases, and the various states of these experiences through deliverables such as user flows, wireframes, prototypes to high fidelity final deliverables. They should be comfortable with an agile approach to design, with an emphasis on user testing and rapid iteration.

Outside exceptional and high-velocity UX/UI thinking and execution, success in this role is dependent on being highly self-motivated, super organized, always open to feedback and critique, and extremely collaborative.

Notably, this role and team focuses heavily on aesthetics and interaction, ensuring that look and feel tells a cohesive and compelling brand story.

Lead UX and UI for a range of projects across multiple strategic work streams, designing for our most complex E-commerce user journeys including shop and activation.
Create user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and final pixel perfect deliverables based on requirements from Product and various stakeholders.
Cultivate a deep understanding of Peloton’s existing product experience across multi-platforms as well as the design systems to ensure future iterations are executed with a cohesive experience.
Work closely and collaboratively with UX Researcher, Content Designer, Product Managers, Engineers and various business stakeholders to fulfill the overall product/feature vision.
Manage your bandwidth and project pipeline to execute designs in time with your team’s software roadmap.
Build out multi-version comps for user testing and iterate quickly based on learnings found in user testing.
Provide prototypes/deliverables to describe interactions and motion to enhance UI.
Execute final, “pixel perfect” UI designs and package, spec, and prep for engineering including responsive designs across multi-breakpoints.
QA developed features for visual perfection, and provide detailed feedback to engineering towards revisions.
Maintain design systems and libraries in conjunction with the wider Product Design Team to ensure product-wide visual consistency.

6+ Years of experience at consumer-focused technology companies.
Comfortable juggling multiple projects.
Low ego approach and highly collaborative
Focused and dedicated to how e-commerce products “function” with a mobile first mindset and how users funnel through the experience to accomplish their goals.
· Strong, proven skill in creating concepts to final pixel perfect deliverables. And a deeply collaborative and iterative approach to product design, focused on ensuring a unified experience across experiences.
Attention to detail and ability to conceptualize multi-state
Exceptional design velocity: especially in developing concepts and variations.
· Excellent communication and organization skills.
Experience designing for various screen sizes for fully responsive web experiences.
· Excellent in interaction design fundamentals, UI design best practices, and accessibility guidelines.
Familiarity with agile software development
Exists on the cutting edge of UX design – and pushes our user research, testing, and design infrastructure and practices.
Experience in building element-based UI design library and style guide
· Knowledge of page animations and interaction design
Has designed or contributed to design systems
Proficiency with Figma, Principle, After Effects other prototyping tools

Prototype and test AI-driven concepts, using data and user feedback to refine interaction patterns pre- and post-launch.

Contribute to and help evolve design patterns and guidelines for AI-enabled experiences across the web ecosystem.
Clearly communicate design rationale, prototypes, and outcomes to your manager and cross-functional partners.

4+ years of relevant product or web design experience, ideally within a B2B SaaS environment.
Exposure to designing for or with AI-powered features (chatbots, recommendation systems, generative content, personalization engines, etc.) — or strong enthusiasm and aptitude to grow into it.
Solid foundation in UI/UX principles, including interaction design, information architecture, and accessibility.
Comfort designing within real-world technical constraints and working closely with engineers to bring ideas to life.
A portfolio that shows thoughtful, user-centered problem solving — bonus points for conversational, adaptive, or AI-enabled interfaces.
Strong communication skills and the ability to clearly present design decisions to a range of stakeholders.
Ability to work through ambiguity, take feedback well, and iterate quickly.

Tahle role je vhodná pro člověka, který už má zkušenost s designem digitálních produktů a chce převzít širší ownership. Nehledáme pouze někoho, kdo umí vytvořit kvalitní obrazovku. s.t:

We are seeking an AI Product Designer (Contractor) that would be designing the AI parts of what our creators use. The work you ship here reaches all of them within weeks.
A lot of this has no established pattern yet. You would be one of the people working it out, on a product people already use every day. Generative creation, agentic workflows, video generation, and the surfaces where creation and automation meet are all moving at once, and video is a big part of where we are heading.

Your role might also develop over time, to keep up with the change. You would own how the system behaves, creation experiences across web and mobile and the connections between them.
Design is three disciplines at Picsart: Product Design, User Research and UX Writing. You would work alongside actual researchers and writers, with engineering and product partners who want you in the problem early rather than at the handoff.
How You'll Make an Impact
Prototyping and testing quickly with a mix of design, AI and code-based tools.
Getting real prototypes in front of creators early, because a static frame cannot tell you how a generative experience feels.
Using research and data to keep the work tied to how creators actually create.
Working with product, engineering, data science, growth and marketing on the same problems from the start.
Shaping how a creator's assets and outputs get surfaced and reused through search, recommendations and automation.
Working in Cascade, our design system. Use it, push on it, and add to it when this work outgrows what is there.
Helping define what good looks like for AI-native design here, for you and for the people around you.

The craft you built in traditional design work, carried into the AI workflow. Typography, layout, spacing, hierarchy, motion, states, edge cases. Speed from AI tools does not change that bar, and we would love to see how you hold it when the output is generated.
5+ years designing consumer-facing products, ideally SaaS, creative tools or productivity platforms.
Experience designing complex systems and workflows such as content platforms, dashboards, automation tools or multi-surface ecosystems, and the systems thinking to design past individual screens.
Comfort with AI-assisted design workflows and rapid prototyping.
Familiarity with front-end code or code-based prototyping, including vibe coding. We would like to see something you built that way.
Judgement about when a system should suggest, draft, act, or stop and ask.
Experience improving key flows such as activation, retention and engagement.
Strong communication. You can explain a decision and take a challenge to it.
A portfolio showing end-to-end thinking and work that moved something.
Good To Have
Designing AI-powered features such as generation, search, recommendations, auto-tagging or smart organisation.
Video or content-production workflows.
File systems, cloud storage or asset management tools.
An interest in AI-native experiences that go past the UI patterns we all have today.
Motion and animation craft.

What we seek and value most in our candidates
Professionalism in both soft and hard skills; motivation to grow, learn and share, positive attitude, flexibility, transparency, ownership and the most important - passion and commitment.

As a Senior Product Designer for Kiosk, you will end-to-end own and elevate the guest-facing ordering experience across thousands of global restaurant locations. By combining exceptional interaction craft with strong product sense, you will define the product roadmap, design intuitive interfaces, and directly drive key guest funnel outcomes like completion rates, average ticket size, and ordering speed.
This is a contract, hybrid role with a flexible work schedule, offering 3 days in our Paris office and 2 days from the comfort of your home.

Set the multi-quarter design vision and end-to-end guest experience (approx. 30%): Own every guest-facing touchpoint—attract screen, menu browsing, item customization, upsell, checkout, payment hand-off, confirmation, and edge states—ensuring consumer-grade polish under fixed hardware and fluorescent lighting conditions .
Define and own the Kiosk guest product roadmap (approx. 25%): Drive measurable guest-funnel metrics (order completion rate, time-to-order, attach rate, average ticket size, abandonment points) by synthesizing behavioral data, restaurant visits, support insights, and competitive teardowns into prioritized product briefs and sequencing decisions .
Prototype, validate, and deliver design-to-code specs (approx. 15%): Build high-fidelity interactive and code-based prototypes to validate flows with real guests before development, delivering detailed specs (tokens, states, motion, accessibility) and conducting design QA on staging builds to enforce the design-code contract .
Architect and govern the Kiosk white-label design system (approx. 15%): Design and evolve a multi-tenant system that maintains visual integrity across hundreds of distinct restaurant brand identities, varied hardware types, poor assets, and internationalization standards (European Accessibility Act / WCAG 2.2 and multi-language/RTL layouts) .
Leverage AI workflows and drive cross-functional leadership (approx. 15%): Supercharge research, spec writing, and ideation using AI tools to accelerate delivery from discovery to ship in weeks; bring engineers, PMs, and commercial leads across global regions to clear decisions; and mentor peer designers through pairing and critique .

5+ years of experience in product design with an outstanding portfolio demonstrating visual craft, interaction design, and product thinking (experience in Kiosk, POS, in-store ordering, checkout, or payments is strongly preferred) .
Bachelor’s degree in Design, HCI, or equivalent practical work experience .
Demonstrated product sense with experience writing briefs, establishing roadmap priorities, running experiments, and driving funnel metrics when operating with or without a dedicated PM .
Hands-on experience architecting and scaling complex white-label or multi-brand design systems, including working knowledge of EAA/WCAG accessibility and multi-language/RTL support .
Code-aware background with a strong understanding of frontend capabilities, technical logic, and performance constraints to effectively partner with engineers on technical implementation .
AI-native mindset, leveraging AI tools as a daily productivity lever for research, ideation, spec creation, and high-fidelity prototyping .
Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, with proven ability to present ideas, negotiate scope trade-offs, align global cross-functional stakeholders, and mentor team members .

The team works closely with design, engineering, and analytics to build scalable financial products that empower people to manage their money with confidence. We rely on empathy, curiosity, and business sense to prioritize features and improve experiences. We’re looking for a Product Designer to join us in supporting our post-purchase experience and international expansion. Design serves a vital role at Affirm: from building narratives through data to creating products that help people make important financial decisions. As a designer, you are responsible for crafting experiences that build trust, confidence and deliver on our principles of honest, transparent financial products.
We’re at a critical inflection point in Affirm’s journey, with millions of people engaging with our products and new opportunities to expand how they use Affirm every day. We’re also growing globally, reaching new customers in new geographies every day.
This Product Designer will help shape our post-purchase experiences, as well as building the next new geographies that Affirm will expand into.

You can demonstrate a breadth of design experience leveraging your ability to create delightful experiences that simplify our customers’ payment management experience through Affirm as well as contributing to our wider international expansion strategy. You’ll partner well with design leadership, design research, and content design.

You’ll work end-to-end, from contributing towards Design and Product vision to delivering class leading design.

You are able to work closely with Product and Engineering to tailor unique customer experiences for our merchants & consumers while ensuring cohesion to the core Affirm experience - championing our customers needs no matter where their journey starts.

Lead end-to-end design for key initiatives within our UK and international experiences, as well as our post purchase experiences globally, across App and Web. You’ll be driving from discovery through to delivery and iteration—achieving meaningful customer and business outcomes.
Own complex flows and ambiguous problem spaces, defining clear problem statements, success metrics, and design direction.
Partner closely with product, engineering, and data to make informed trade-offs and deliver intuitive, high-quality experiences.
Balance speed and quality, making pragmatic decisions while contributing to a cohesive product experience.
Use research, data, and experimentation to inform decisions and continuously improve outcomes.
Contribute to design systems and patterns, strengthening consistency and scalability across your area.
Facilitate alignment and decision-making, ensuring teams move forward with clarity.
Support and mentor other designers, helping raise the quality of work across the team.
What we look for
Strong Craft & Execution: You consistently deliver polished, thoughtful interaction and visual design with high attention to detail.
Product Thinking: You balance user needs, business goals, and technical constraints to make sound design decisions and improve end-to-end experiences.
Ownership & Initiative: You take ownership of ambiguous problems and drive work forward with minimal oversight.
Cross-functional Collaboration: You build strong partnerships, communicate clearly, and help teams align on decisions and trade-offs.
Data-Informed Decision Making: You use research, experimentation, and analytics to guide your work and iterate toward better outcomes.
Team-Level Influence: You’re a trusted design partner within your area, contributing to direction and improving how the team works.
Growth & Adaptability: You seek feedback, continuously improve your craft, and leverage modern tools—including AI—to accelerate your workflow.
Tools & Experience: Proficiency with modern design and collaboration tools (Figma, G Suite, Notion, etc.).
5+ years of product design experience or equivalent practical experience.

You’ll design financial products that genuinely help people.
You’ll work on high-impact experiences used by millions of customers.
You’ll join a team that values craft, collaboration, and thoughtful iteration.
You’ll have the opportunity to grow your scope, influence, and leadership over time.

Staff Product Designer, Commercial Growth
Squarespace's Commercial Growth organization brings together the product, engineering, and strategy teams responsible for how Squarespace builds, prices, and grows its business across every product line. Within that org, the Commercial Product team owns the customer-facing experiences that drive purchase, adoption, and expansion — from the moment a prospective customer discovers Squarespace to the point they convert, upgrade, and grow.
We're looking for a Staff Product Designer to own the end-to-end commercial experience across cart, checkout, cross-sell, and pricing pages.

This is a high-leverage, high-visibility role at the intersection of monetization strategy and product craft — translating pricing, packaging, and bundling goals into scalable, intuitive user experiences that work across Squarespace's full product portfolio. This is a Player–Coach individual contributor role at the Staff level.

You'll bring deep systems thinking and exceptional craft to some of the most commercially consequential surfaces in the product, while also serving as a force multiplier for the broader Commercial Growth design community. This role reports to the Director of GTM Product Design.
This is the right role for a senior designer who understands that commercial UX is not just a conversion problem — it's a systems problem. If you can hold the full arc from Frontsite discovery through post-purchase expansion, think in merchandising patterns and interaction models rather than one-off flows, and partner credibly with product, engineering, and revenue systems counterparts, this role is built for you.
You’ll Get To…
Own the Commercial Product Design Surface: Lead design across plan selection, cart merchandising, and cross-sell — creating cohesive, intentional experiences across the full commercial ecosystem rather than isolated flows.
Translate Monetization Strategy into Scalable UX: Work closely with Commercial Strategy to translate pricing, packaging, bundling, discounting, and messaging requirements into flexible, reusable design patterns that hold up across products and offers.
Design Cross-Sell and Merchandising Systems: Develop cross-sell placements, supporting assets, and interaction models tied to targeting strategy — designing for flexibility so that what works for one product line can scale across others.
Partner Across Product, Engineering, and RevSys: Collaborate closely with product and engineering leaders on customer-facing purchase and conversion flows, and work with RevSys counterparts where commercial product experiences depend on shared systems or implementation constraints.
Connect Frontsite to Downstream Conversion: Extend design thinking across Frontsite-connected journeys so that discovery and downstream conversion feel intentional and connected — not like separate experiences owned by separate teams.
Partner with Platform and Data Science on Targeting and Experimentation: Work alongside Platform and Data Science teams when targeting logic or experimentation affects the user experience, ensuring that personalization and testing are designed with the customer journey in mind.
Establish Design Consistency Across Commercial Growth: Help raise the design bar across the newly unified Commercial Growth organization — establishing patterns, principles, and standards that create coherence across a complex, multi-surface ecosystem.
Mentor and Elevate Craft: Serve as a craft mentor across Commercial Growth design as we expand — giving sharp, actionable feedback, pairing with designers on complex systems problems, and raising the quality bar for both systems thinking and visual and interaction design.

10+ years of experience in product design at a digital product company, including time operating at a Staff or equivalent level.
A portfolio demonstrating complex, systems-level work — ideally across commerce, checkout, pricing, or monetization surfaces — with clear impact on user and business outcomes.
Experience leading cross-functional workstreams from ambiguity to shipped product, including setting direction, defining milestones, and aligning stakeholders across product, engineering, and data teams.
A track record of translating business and monetization requirements — pricing, packaging, discounting, merchandising — into scalable, intuitive UX patterns that work across a broad product portfolio.
Strong systems thinking: you architect experiences that feel simple by mapping data models, flows, and dependencies across multiple product areas.
High-agency operator who can create momentum without fully defined requirements — you impose structure on ambiguous problems by framing the space, surfacing constraints, and clarifying goals for others.
Experience designing for or alongside experimentation and targeting systems, with an understanding of how personalization and A/B logic affect the user experience.
Exceptional communication and storytelling skills — you can zoom from high-level strategy to concrete UX decisions with clarity, and you're comfortable representing design rationale to senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
You lead by example, setting a craft and systems bar that other designers actively look to emulate, and you enjoy coaching designers at different levels.
Experience working on Frontsite or marketing-site-connected journeys, with an understanding of how discovery and conversion relate across the funnel, is a strong plus.

This is an opportunity to help shape the products and experiences that support the work of Chartis from the ground up. As Staff Product Designer, you will design end-to-end experiences for the tools and platforms our teams rely on, partnering closely with product managers and engineering to translate complex problems into interfaces that are clear, efficient, and trustworthy.
Our users are sophisticated. They work in high-stakes, time-pressured environments with deep analytical rigor and keen attention to detail. We need a designer who finds that reality energizing, someone who brings the same rigor, curiosity, and care to every product they touch, whatever the audience.
We are a brand new product team, which means there’s lots of room to make a big impact and grow. You will take ownership of your design work from discovery through delivery and contribute to new standards and design systems that help our products and team scale.
You will report to the design manager and work closely with product managers, engineers, and subject matter experts across Chartis’ to build impactful products and advocate for design excellence at all stages of the product lifecycle.

Product and UX/UI Design
Design products and features end to end, from initial concept through launch and ongoing improvement, for tools that directly impact Chartis consulting teams and their clients.
Take messy, real-world workflows and turn them into interfaces that are clear, efficient, and trustworthy, no matter how complicated the systems behind them are.
Design for AI-assisted workflows, including surfaces where users interpret model outputs, review recommendations, and collaborate alongside AI and human teammates to carry out their consulting work.

Product Designer
In the 1960s, the Italian artist and inventor Bruno Munari was studying spontaneous forms: shapes that emerge from the interaction of material, function, and environment.
When Danese Milano commissioned him to design a lamp that was practical, durable, affordable, and easy to transport, Munari was reminded of the traditional rice paper lanterns he had encountered when traveling in Japan. But rice paper lanterns are fragile, hard to clean, and tend to yellow over time.
Looking for an industrial alternative, he discovered filanca—a synthetic stretch nylon used exclusively for women's stockings at the time.
Munari visited hosiery factories to test the material and see what forms it could take. "We do not make lamps, sir. Only stockings," one factory told him. Munari replied, "You'll see."
The result was the Falkland lamp: only a few centimeters thick when packaged, as tall as a human when hung, its spontaneous form emerging from the elasticity of the nylon and metal rings of different diameters inserted at regular intervals, enlarged by gravity when suspended from above.
Munari didn't begin with the form of a lamp. He began with the qualities it needed, then looked outside the conventions of lighting to find the right materials and methods. We're looking for a designer who works the same way: someone who studies the systems and materials at hand, then finds a way of putting them together that feels both unexpected and inevitable.
At Co–Star, the materials are a 4,000-year-old system of astrology, planetary data from NASA, and a corpus written by astrologers and poets. The qualities we're designing for: astrology made accessible without asking anyone to learn a complex system, and a language that lets people share something intimate with their friends.
We're hiring a Senior Product Designer to continue cultivating those qualities across Co–Star and new experiments. You'll move between product architecture, interaction design, prototyping, and visual design. Ideas rarely arrive as polished specs. You'll help decide what we make next and how it works.
